one_line: Pandya king of the Sangam Age, remembered in poetry for his victory at Talaiyalanganam and his rule from Madurai.

appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, medium-dark Tamil complexion, straight prominent nose, intense narrow brown eyes with thick brows, short neatly trimmed mustache and small goatee, a faint scar across his left cheek, default expression calm and commanding with a hint of stern focus.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back and tied in a short, high warrior topknot at the back of the crown, sides clean and orderly, adorned with a simple gold frontlet band across the forehead with a tiny central leaf-shaped ornament.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early 3rd-century Pandya royal-warrior attire: an off-white, finely woven cotton veshti wrapped dhoti-style from waist to ankles with neat front pleats and a narrow dark maroon border; a fitted short-sleeved upper cloth in muted deep blue cotton covering the torso, layered over by a broad chest harness of dark brown leather straps holding small rectangular bronze plates aligned over the upper chest and shoulders; over this, a rich maroon silk-angavastram style shawl with a subtle gold edge draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, secured with a small circular gold brooch; on the waist, a sturdy dark brown leather war-belt with simple bronze fittings, from which hangs a short side panel of quilted dark blue cotton acting as a hip-guard; feet in brown leather sandals strapped around the ankles; jewellery limited to a pair of medium-sized plain gold ear-rings, a single thick gold armlet on the right upper arm engraved with a stylized fish motif, and a simple beaded rudraksha-and-gold necklace lying just below the collarbone, all giving a restrained royal dignity without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly leaf-shaped straight sword of early South Indian style with a bronze hilt and disc pommel, carried at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with bronze tip, usually gripped in his right hand with the blade angled downward in relaxed readiness.

ref_desc: Nedunjeliyan II is a mid-30s, medium-dark Tamil king with an oval face, cheek scar, warrior topknot with a gold frontlet, maroon-bordered off-white veshti, deep blue upper cloth, leather-and-bronze chest harness, maroon shawl, gold fish-armlet, and a leaf-shaped bronze-hilted sword at his hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nedunjeliyan II, a mid-30s athletic Pandya king with medium-dark Tamil complexion, oval face, faint scar on his left cheek, intense brown eyes, short mustache and small goatee, and thick black hair tied in a high warrior topknot with a simple gold frontlet band. Show him in historically grounded early 3rd-century South Indian royal-warrior attire: off-white cotton veshti wrapped dhoti-style to the ankles with a narrow dark maroon border, a fitted short-sleeved deep blue upper cloth covering the torso, and a dark brown leather chest harness bearing small rectangular bronze plates across chest and shoulders. Over this, drape a rich maroon silk-like shawl with subtle gold edging from the left shoulder across his chest and around his back, pinned by a small circular gold brooch. Give him a sturdy dark brown leather war-belt with bronze fittings and a quilted dark blue hip-guard panel, brown leather sandals strapped around the ankles, and restrained jewellery: plain gold earrings, a single thick gold armlet with a carved fish motif on the right arm, and a short rudraksha-and-gold necklace. At his left hip, show a long slightly leaf-shaped straight sword with a bronze hilt and disc pommel in a dark brown leather scabbard, and in some views he holds the sword in his right hand with the blade angled down, all in a consistent palette of maroon, deep blue, off-white, dark brown, and gold.
